Taiwan: US citizens get up to 90 visa-free days, counted from the day after arrival.

US passport must cover the stay. Carry confirmed return/onward travel; submit Taiwan Arrival Card within 7 days before arrival.

posts.text:
Canada: US citizens need neither visitor visa nor eTA. Visits are usually allowed for up to 6 months; the officer can set a different end date.

Travel with a valid US passport and follow any date on the entry record.

posts.text:
United Kingdom: US tourists can visit visa-free for up to 6 months, normally with an ETA before travel. Fee: GBP 20.

Passport must cover the whole stay; show funds and plans to leave after the visit.
posts.alt: UK photo and US tourist-entry rules: visa-free for up to 6 months, with a passport covering the stay, funds and plans to leave. An ETA is normally required before travel: GBP 20 per application, including children. British or Irish citizenship or existing UK permission may create an individual ETA exemption. Checked October 20, 2026.
